cases.input: Run headless. Use bmad-agent-po (Sofia) to distill files/relay-prd.md into a new initiative under _bmad-output/ and slice it into epics.
rubric: Four epics exist in the initiative's tickets/tickets.toml matching the PRD Epic map names and order verbatim (Arrival & Check-in, Queue & Triage, Rooming & Handoff, Follow-up & Billing).
tickets.py status on the initiative shows valid ids and zero cycles or order conflicts.
Each epic traces to its PRD entry through covers and Requirements lines.
Unowned long-horizon OKR-03 is flagged explicitly in the initiative file's Notes (not silently dropped or only mentioned in chat).

cases.input: Run headless. Use bmad-agent-po (Sofia) to turn files/shift-swap-brief.md into the ticket tree under _bmad-output/ at internal company stakes.
rubric: Creates one standalone epic (epic-*) rather than splitting into multiple epics or rollout-phase epics (no 12-store or 48-store rollout epic).
Leaves the epic unrefined (refined: false) because open product questions remain (partial shifts, 24h auto-approve), and records those gaps plus the missing success measure as Open question: lines.
Never invents answers to the open product questions or writes Assumption: lines deciding partial shifts or auto-approve.
Never loads bmad-agent-pm, bmad-agent-ux-designer, bmad-agent-architect, or bmad-facilitate inline; recommends John in a fresh chat in the report.

cases.input: Run headless. Use bmad-agent-po (Sofia) to check and reconcile all unadopted runs in files/case-contradiction/epic-checkin.
rubric: Reads all unadopted runs in one pass without modifying prd-epic-checkin.md, ux-epic-checkin/EXPERIENCE.md, or arch-epic-checkin/arch-epic-checkin.md.
Surfaces the contradiction between verified-account requirement (E01-FR-01) and anonymous guest kiosk flow (EXPERIENCE.md) as a Source conflict: line without silently picking a winner.
Does not adopt the draft arch-epic-checkin.md into companions: (flags it as unfinished draft instead).

cases.input: Run headless. Use bmad-agent-po (Sofia) to slice files/case-detail/epic-checkout into stories and complete epic-inception story detailing so the stories are ready to build.
rubric: Creates tickets/tickets.toml with 1-2 sentence outcome descriptions, refine = true on each entry, no standalone go-live story, and UI references citing DESIGN.md, EXPERIENCE.md#cart-flow, and mockups/cart.html (plus arch-epic-checkout).

Pulls and details Refined Story markdown files (tickets/story-*.md) with refined: true, Given/When/Then functional + failure + measurement criteria citing epic R<n> and E01-FR-xx ids, and zero copied epic spec prose or source-code file paths.
Every epic R<n> line (including instrumentation R3) is covered by both covers and at least one acceptance criterion across the story set, and tickets.py body succeeds for each story.
tickets.py next lists the approved stories under ready_to_start with zero cycles or drift.

cases.input: Run headless. Use bmad-agent-po (Sofia) to turn files/hobby-brief.md into the ticket tree under _bmad-output/. Keep it light for this personal weekend project.
rubric: Proceeds directly with Sofia (records Open question: lines for CSV vs Discogs and theme, keeps requirements concise, does not bounce the user through John/Sally/Winston specialist gates or load specialist skills inline).
Keeps the work as a single lightweight standalone epic or standalone story without over-splitting into multiple epics.

cases.input: Run headless. Use bmad-agent-po (Sofia) to refine files/case-refine/epic-alerts by adopting its final PRD run.
rubric: Adopts files/case-refine/epic-alerts/prd-epic-alerts/prd-epic-alerts.md in one pass into sources: and companions:, writing Requirements R<n> lines citing all E02-FR-01..04 ids plus a dedicated R<n> line for alert_delivery_latency_ms instrumentation.
Sets refined: true on epic-alerts.md so tickets.py status shows has_spec: true and unrefined_epics: [].
